accessor.name: EPDF_GetPageUserUnitByIndex
accessor.signature: (document: Ptr, zeroBasedPageIndex: number, outFloat32: Ptr) => boolean
accessor.semantics: Reads parsed page dictionary; missing or nonpositive UserUnit defaults to 1. Invalid document, page index or null output returns false. Probe checks actual float32 out-pointer writes and guard bytes.

maintainedSuccessor.finding: Raw FPDF dimensions omit UserUnit. The published successor exports the native scalar accessor, so no custom bridge is required. The test-only probe derives bitmap dimensions from that accessor without oracle-supplied geometry.

officialAPI.finding: Official upstream FPDF size functions use intersected page boxes and intrinsic rotation without UserUnit scaling. This statement is limited to upstream FPDF APIs; the published EmbedPDF successor separately provides EPDF_GetPageUserUnitByIndex.
